profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Xbox
profile.summary: I am currently working on the Xbox PC app in conjunction with building the shared software used by most of Xbox’s client apps. I’ve historically been a full-stack iOS developer, having worked on 4 Xbox iOS apps, 2 native and 2 React-Native: SmartGlass (original Xbox companion app), Mixer Create, Mixer, and the new Xbox app.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Co-op on the iOS Mobile Connections Team.

positions.title: Lab assistant
positions.description: I am a lab assistant for a robotics seminar course (4003-590-03)

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I am currently working on a prototype robot that's main focus is human-robot interaction. Currently, students majoring in CS or SE at RIT take an intro class to programming that teaches python. The goal is to have the students write a python script, send it to the robot via wifi, and have the robot do this task. Example would be to move from point A to B. The human-robot interaction happens when the robot is incapable of doing a task entirely by itself and asks a human for help.
